decisions.reason: As a flagship digital product line close to the firm's core practice management software and regulatory workflow knowledge, the firm can readily assimilate early feedback and improve it.

The continuing education institute, while related to existing training content, requires distinct regulatory and educational capabilities and has shown only a minor website presence, indicating limited absorptive capacity and weak early results.
The remote screen sharing support tool builds directly on the firm's existing support resources and integration capabilities, allowing it to be easily assimilated and maintained.
